MIND. [1] [All. c.]
Very melancholy. θ Catarrh.
Indefinable anxiety ; walks about, and finally full of apprehension, throws himself on the bed and now gets up again ; constant violent pains in left side of abdomen, more in middle and lower part of abdomen and in region of bladder, with troubles in urinating and no stool ; violent thirst ; face expressive of anxiety and doubt ; skin hot, especially in painful and sensitive places ; pulse somewhat accelerated, full and hard.
Fears she will become distracted, from pain in suppuration of fingers.
Confused and absent-minded, in afternoon after wine and coffee.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [All. c.]
Dulness, pressure, fulness, heaviness in head, most in occiput, < evenings, > in open air, and < when returning to a warm room.
Dulness and confusion of head. θ Coryza. θ Whooping cough.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [All. c.]
Dull frontal headache. θ Coryza.
Pain in forehead, with catarrh.
Pains in both temples, most severe in right, < by winking ; afterwards the pain extends over forehead, < on left side.
Pain in temples, < after motion of eyelids.
Headache, first in occiput, then in forehead, over right eye.
Intense pain in occipital region and cervical spine. θ Influenza.
Severe headache, with slight coryza.
An electric shock passes through head.
Dull headache, with coryza ; < in evening, > in open air, but aggravated when returning to a warm room.
Catarrhal headache.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [All. c.]
Numbness in bones of skull, as if asleep.
Prickling sweat on bald vertex after each meal.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [All. c.]
Dullness of eyes, with aversion to light. θ Coryza. θ Pertussis.
Letters appear smaller ; when getting sleepy, eyes dull, dim and sensitive to light. θ Coryza.
Burning, biting and smarting of eyes as from smoke, wants to rub them.
Itching, burning, stinging of eyes.
Eyes red, itching, and sensitive to touch, left worse.
Eyes watery and suffused, capillaries injected. θ Coryza.
Excessive lachrymation, with redness of eyeballs, with frequent sneezing. θ Coryza.
Lachrymation of left eye, with coryza, was much greater, eye was much redder and more sensitive to light than right.
Profuse bland lachrymation. θ Coryza.
Lachrymation is for most part in evening in warm room ; l. eye weeps most and is more sensitive to light.
Shooting pain in right lachrymal duct.
Winks with eyes, with pain in temples.
Smarting of inner surface of upper lids.
Swelling of lids and around eyes. θ Coryza.
Thread-like pain : over right eye, towards root of nose ; from cheek towards eye.
Catarrhal ophthalmia. θ Whooping cough.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [All. c.]
Tinnitus. θ Pertussis.
Hardness or dulness of hearing.
Stitches towards ear from left forehead.
Pain, like thick threads, towards ear from deep within head.
Pains jerking from throat towards eustachian tube.
Earache.
Discharge of pus from ear.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [All. c.]
Epistaxis.
Dryness of anterior nares.
Nose stopped, nasal voice.
A feeling of tightness at root of nose.
Constant sneezing, with profuse acrid coryza, < on coming into a warm room. θ Pertussis.
Immediately after rising from bed in morning violent sneezing, as if it would tear her to pieces.
Frequent sneezing, lachrymation, pain in forehead, acrid discharge from nostril, hacking cough on inspiration cold air, cold alternates with heat.
Profuse nasal discharge. θ Scarlatina.
Acrid discharge from left nostril.
Spring coryza.
Colds after damp northeasterly winds.
Fluent coryza, with headache, tears from eyes, feels hot and thirsty, with want of appetite ; cough and trembling of hands ; < evenings and in-doors ; > in open air.
Ichor oozing out of nose. θ Second stage of scarlatina.
Ichorous fluid from nose, when singing. θ Convalescence from scarlatina.
Acrid watery discharge dropping from tip of nose.
Dropping from nose, watery discharge, burning and corroding nose and upper lip.
Spring coryza ; tingling and itching in right nostril.
Every year, in August, morning coryza, with violent sneezing ; very sensitive to odor of flowers and skin of peaches (lasting two or three weeks).
Catarrh, with watering and smarting eyes, with violent sneezing ; he must "take a long breath", and then sneezes correspondingly.
Violent catarrh, after northeast wind and rainy weather ; eyes suffused, lids very red, as from crying and rubbing them ; nose dropping, throat sore, and some cough.
Coryza : after chilliness ; after flushes of heat at evening.
Coryza, with burning of edges of nose, profuse discharge.
Coryza, > in open air and < in warm room. θ Pertussis.
With coryza, trembling of hands, in evening.
Large pieces of a mucous polypus were blown out and dropping of water ceased. θ Polypus.
Nasal polypi.
Burning in edges of nose and lips. θ Coryza.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [All. c.]
Threadlike pains about face, temples and ears. θ Pertussis.
Throbbing, drawing, pressing pains, with swelling of cheek. θ Toothache.
Face hot, especially in evening.
Paralysis of left half of face, also somewhat noticed in limbs of same side, too copious secretion of urine.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [All. c.]
Worse when chewing. θ Toothache.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [All. c.]
Toothache, with coryza, > when catarrh is worse, and < when catarrh ceases.
Toothache in molars, after exposure to damp cold wind, and < in warm room and from warm drinks ; > from cold water and picking or sucking.
Teeth are dirty and turn yellow.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [All. c.]
Disgusting taste in mouth ; sweet and nauseous.
Tongue dirty, slimy and furred, especially in morning.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [All. c.]
Aching like a large lump on root of tongue, roof of mouth, eustachian opening, extends towards ear.
Sensation of fulness and soreness behind palate.
Dryness and smarting above palate.
Dryness in mouth, on root of tongue, on soft palate and in throat.
Bad odor from mouth and throat. θ Toothache.
Expectoration of a lumpy mucus from posterior nares.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [All. c.]
Lumps of mucus from choanæ, in evening, having a nauseous taste.
Tough viscous mucus in fauces and throat.
Jerking pains from throat towards eustachian tube.
Sensation of fulness, soreness and coldness behind palate.
Soreness and dryness of throat. θ Influenza.
Pain in throat below larynx, as after swallowing too large a mouthful, or as if swollen ; pain extends every little while into right ear ; whole afternoon, coming on at midday.
A constrictive pain in forepart of throat, low down in region of os hyoides, later low down posteriorly on r. side.
Sensation as of a ball or lump in throat.
Numb feeling in posterior wall of pharynx.
Coldness in pharynx.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [All. c.]
Canine hunger, or loss of appetite. θ Pertussis. θ Coryza.
Less appetite and increased thirst.
Violent thirst, with a severe cold, frequent sneezing, running of tears, pain in forehead, acrid discharge from left nostril, hacking cough on inspiring cold air.
Thirst. θ Pertussis.
Desire for raw onions. θ Pneumonia. θ Yellow fever.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [All. c.]
Bad effects from eating spoiled fish.
After each meal a prickling sweat on bald vertex.
Stomach weak, cannot bar anything but raw onions. θ Yellow fever.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [All. c.]
Sour eructations.
Belching, with rumbling in and puffing up of abdomen.
Belching, with fever heat.
Nausea, squeamishness, comes from stomach up throat into fauces, more when rising.
Nausea forced up throat, like a thrust.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [All. c.]
Pressure in stomach, with gaping.
Feels a pressure on cardia from behind.
Stomach feels empty, weak.
Pain below sternum to right, in region of pylorus.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [All. c.]
Pressure in region of liver, with crawls along back, and coldness.
Pains begin in hepatic region and spread over abdomen. θ Colic.
Contracting sensation in spleen, with stitches while lying.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [All. c.]
Colicky pain in region of navel, < on sitting, > when walking.
Wind colic. θ Pertussis.
Cutting in belly, like a thread, towards centre.
Colic : from catching cold by getting feet wet ; after eating too much ; after eating cucumbers, salad, etc. ; hemorrhoidal ; of children.
Severe pains in abdomen. θ Pertussis.
Colicky pains, beginning in hepatic region and spreading over whole abdomen, worse around navel ; < when sitting ; > when moving about and by passing flatus.
Violent pain in hypogastrium, to left, with urging to urinate ; burning micturation. θ Incarcerated hernia.
Stitches in loins.
Deep in pelvis on a small spot to right, violent pressure and cutting as with small knives.
Abdomen puffed up, with rumbling, more to left ; ineffectual urging to stool, with heat, some pains, difficult breathing, and inconvenience of clothing ; > after wind passes freely.
Abdomen distended, dull in head, urging to stool ends with diarrhœa.
Violent cutting pain in left lower abdomen, with frequent desire to micturate, and burning micturation.
Annoying pains over middle of groin.
Pressure in left inguinal ring.
Hernia in left groin much protruded and strangulated ; very severe pains from high up in left side of hypochondrium drew towards incarcerated hernia ; very restless ; much fever, etc.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [All. c.]
Flatus very offensive, and moist ; mornings.
Bowels loose, after midnight, or towards morning, with offensive flatus. θ Pertussis.
Constipation, following intermittents treated by quinine.
Difficult passing of feces ; passage interrupted.
Urging without a passage, but stitches in rectum.
Hemorrhoidal pains.
Tearing jerks in anus ; also biting and crawling.
Itching at anus. θ Worms.
Rhagades in anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [All. c.]
Pains in renal region and pressure in region of bladder. θ Pertussis.
Region of bladder very sensitive, child screams if hand is placed there.
In bladder a burning pressure, afterwards in sacrum ; pain in region of kidneys, more left side ; pain in groins.
Pressing and other pains in region of bladder.
Sensation of weakness and warmth in bladder and urethra.
Frequent urinating ; with burning in urethra ; urine very red ; all day, still oftener evenings ; especially with shuddering and chilliness.
Spasmodic strangury after getting feet and bowels cold.
Dribbling or spurting of urine, in old people.
Urine frothy and iridescent.
In albuminuria it diminished urging for frequent urination and also the quantity of albumen in urine.
Polyuria.
Increased secretion of urine. θ Coryza. θ Catarrh. θ Paralysis.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [All. c.]
Increased sexual desire.
After coitus pain in bladder and prostate gland.
Drawing in spermatic cords.
Burning on glans penis and in urethra.
Pain in pubic region.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [All. c.]
Pain in uterine region.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [All. c.]
In childbed, panaritia on several fingers, with red streaks up arm ; pains driving to despair.
After forceps delivery, swelling of whole lower limb, exceedingly painful, mostly in thigh.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [All. c.]
Catarrhal hoarseness. θ Pertussis.
Pain as if larynx would be torn when coughing. θ Coryza.
Tickling in larynx, with hoarseness.
Tickling in throat, with aching in larynx. θ Pertussis.
Throbbing in larynx, and sensation as if it contracted.
Constant inclination to hack in order to relieve tickling in larynx.
Violent catarrhal laryngitis ; hoarse cough seemed to split and tear larynx, causes watering of eyes, etc.
Acute bronchitis, going from left to right.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [All. c.]
Oppressed breathing : from pressure in middle of chest ; < in evening ; in ascites. θ Pertussis.
Hacking and worrying till he cannot breathe. θ Coryza.
He must take a long breath, and then sneezes correspondingly.
On inspiring cold air, hacking cough.
   

COUGH. [27] [All. c.]
Laryngeal cough, frequently repeated. θ Coryza.
Severe laryngeal cough, which compels patient to grasp larynx ; feels as if cough would tear it. θ Coryza.
Hoarse, harsh, ringing, spasmodic cough ; excited by constant tickling in larynx ; cough produces a raw, splitting pain in larynx, so acute and so severe as to compel patient to crouch from suffering, and to make every effort to suppress cough. θ Pertussis.
Frequent cough, tension in upper part of chest, loss of appetite ; < every evening.
Cough, with fulness in head, especially in occiput, with heat, copious fluent acrid coryza and profuse bland lachrymation. θ Whooping cough ;
Cough increases in evening.
Cough brought on by inhaling cold air.
Hacking cough from inhaling cold air.
Constant inclination to hack in order to relieve tickling in larynx.
Spasmodic cough simulating croup.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [All. c.]
Stitches, with burning, in middle of left side of chest, when taking a deep breath.
Pains here and there flitting through chest.
Pressure in upper middle part of chest makes respiration difficult.
Tension in upper part of chest, with coryza and cough.
Rattling in chest.
Tough mucus from chest.
Epidemics of autumnal influenza.
Incipient pneumonia in children.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [All. c.]
Pulse more frequent and full ; or, slow and hard.
Pulse full and accelerated.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [All. c.]
Intense pain in cervical spine. θ Influenza.
Crawls in back ; after sitting, pain under right shoulder blade.
Pain in small of back, if bowels did not move.
Chills run up back. θ Pertussis.
Chilly crawls run down back, most at night, more frequent urination, followed by heat and thirst.
Rigidity of spinal column in periodic attacks, accompanied by pain through whole chest.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [All. c.]
Sweat in axilla.
Pain in right shoulder blade, when lying in bed.
Numbness in left elbow, < on slight motion.
Pain in arms, more left forearm.
Lame sensation in all joints of arm.
Hands red and dry, as if he had been in the cold.
Sweat in palms of hands.
Trembling of right hand, he can hardly write.
Panaritium.
Suppuration, after a prick with a needle, under left thumb nail ; a red streak up to elbow, where a lump the size of a hazelnut is formed.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [All. c.]
Weakness of hips. θ Pertussis. θ Interfering with coitus.
Nettlerash on thighs.
Pain above knees.
Lameness in knee.
Pains in ankle joint.
Sore and raw spots on feet, especially heel, from friction.
Pain in most external soft parts of right great toe, and also in left middle finger.
Brittle hoofs and losing hair, with horses (tincture in water).
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [All. c.]
Soreness in limbs and aching in all bones, as after taking a cold. θ Coryza.
Tired feeling in all limbs.
Neuralgia of stump (after amputation), violent burning stinging pains.
   

NERVES. [36] [All. c.]
Weak and tired, has to lie down.
Lassitude. θ Pertussis.
Traumatic chronic neuritis ; pains violent and wearing out the patient.
   

SLEEP. [37] [All. c.]
Yawning : with headache and cramp in stomach ; with sleepiness ; near objects seem distant.
Gaping in deep sleep.
Restless sleep, drowsy in morning.
At evening, walking in street, increased dropping from nose, from both nostrils, without sensation of coryza.
Wakes nights at 2 A. M., with excited pulse ; cannot sleep again till morning ; without any chill, only heat without any thirst ; disappears mornings, but is < again for a few hours after breakfast, afterwards much prostrated.
Dreams : of being near the water ; of battles, fights, precipices and deep wells ; of storms at sea, high waves ; annoying, in convalescents.
   

TIME. [38] [All. c.]
Worse in afternoon and evening ; when lying down. θ Pertussis.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [All. c.]
Colds and toothache after damp cold wind and weather.
Bad effects from getting feet wet.
Patient likes to wash himself frequently and is fond of being in open air. θ Toothache.
   

FEVER. [40] [All. c.]
Coldness alternates with heat. θ Catarrh.
Chills, followed by fever. θ Influenza.
Heat in head, on head, in brows, in face, in cheeks, in throat down to stomach and bowels.
Heat with coryza, alternating with cold and flitting heat over whole body and thirst ; evenings.
Attacks of flushes of heat. θ Coryza.
Heat and thirst, with rumbling in belly. θ Coryza.
Heat, without thirst, 2 A. M., passes off by morning, < again after breakfast.
Heat. θ Pertussis.
Sweats easily and copiously.
Yellow fever.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [All. c.]
Commencing left side, going to right. θ Coryza. θ Colds.
   

TISSUES. [44] [All. c.]
Inflammations and increased secretion of mucous membranes. θ Coryza. θ Pertussis.
Gangrena senilis, woman, æt. 80 (externally as a salve).
Phlegmasia alba dolens, after instrumental delivery.
Brittle hoofs and falling out of hair, in horses.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [All. c.]
Traumatic neuritis, pains violent and continuous, wearing out the patient.
After hurts and lesions, stiffness in back and periodic attacks, trismus and pain in chest.
   

SKIN. [46] [All. c.]
Pricking, like from pins or needles, in skin, especially on head, on forehead, in brows, on throat and on r. arm.
Redness and itching of skin.
Nettlerash on thighs.
Measles, with strongly marked catarrhal symptoms.
Scarlatina, with characteristic running from nose and urinary symptoms.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [All. c.]
Children. θ Coryza. θ Pertussis. θ Pneumonia.
